notes: 2026-01-12 — Intro call (FF: ff_2026-01-12_Whitecliff_intro). ResearchOps + Head of Data present.
Use-case: firmwide research portal for sell-side equity research + derivatives desk. Mix of PDFs, SEC filings, internal models, research notes.
